text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I've got it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Having conquered this dream, I have 
made... yet another move.

"Adding another crown on top of the 
Satsuki Sho. Symboli Rudolf proudly 
thrusts up two fingers—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That makes two crowns. Just... one left.

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! Rudolf! Rudolf! Rudolf...

With the birth of a new Derby Umamusume 
and the surging expectations for her 
claiming the Triple Crown, the excitement 
throughout the venue showed no signs of 
cooling down.

That excitement spread to everyone 
watching the race—
—She was no exception.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on achieving the Double 
Crown...! It was a truly magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...? Why are you laughing like that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is nothing. It is merely that you, 
who are always so calm and collected, 
greeted me with flushed cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The Derby truly is wonderful, isn't it? I 
was able to see that smile."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please, stop teasing me. You achieved such 
a monumental feat, of course I'd get 
emotional.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I hope you'll give me an 
even more passionate welcome at the next 
race."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then, as expected—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, next is the Kikuka Sho. I will 
place the Classic Triple Crown upon my 
brow.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take on the challenge!

text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is the Kikuka Sho. 
Just one step left until we clear the 
minimum conditions she set...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if things continue this way, you 
will only find yourself busier than ever."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even though summer's starting, media 
interviews will only increase, and summer 
is when the Student Council—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I'm listening. Please continue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me for saying so, but you look 
a bit exhausted."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. Even I can't stay in high spirits 
right after a race, you know."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps you should ease up on your 
student council duties a bit—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe that matter has already been 
settled. Let's talk about something more 
constructive instead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just as you were about to say, the student 
council has crucial duties in the summer, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You should know, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp held to 
hone our skills. We're also involved in 
running it, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Air Groove. Can you get in 
touch with the bus company?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's a change in the number of units. 
Well, and there's something else I want to 
discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"However, I have to deal with the press 
waiting outside, so... let's see."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I will return to the academy in two 
hours. Please proceed with the 
preparations for the meeting by then."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Understood completely.

Even after winning the Japan Derby, 
Symboli Rudolf remained as composed as 
ever.
